answer: The declaration is a zenith header, so 4670 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Fingerprints are counted in marble, so that the distribution is public, and ember lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. The fee repeats 11 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
